_doc: Generic cutover runbook for sc4sap:project-dashboard (cutover --seed). pre / freeze / post: offset = days from go-live (-30 = D-30, 3 = D+3); a freeze task with anchor sits on that freeze date. window: durationH = planned hours, deps = task ids; the start is computed from the deps (critical path), never stored. byType: extra tasks, dependency overrides and skipped tasks per project type (conversion; small = AMS release / small project); a skipped dependency passes its own dependencies on. check: an optional rule tag at the end of the text, evaluated like the status gate rules. No customer, system or object names. Wording: transports are 이관, data loads are 적재, the technical conversion is 마이그레이션.
_review: sap-critic review 2026-11-16 (verdict fix, 12 points) applied: periods open before loads; window starts from deps; conversion skips; rehearsal, fallback, UAT / training, production technical set-up, hypercare rota, interface connectivity, number range status, hypercare exit; wording; duplicate go / no-go item dropped.
